summary:
Empirical Playwright verification (desktop 1280x900, fullscreen Format editor on https://color-task-timer.preview.emergentagent.com) of the BLOCK Return-exit repair at FloatingRichTextToolbar.jsx L2095-2126. ALL 11 scenarios from the review_request PASS. The newly-added BLOCK branch below the INLINE branch correctly strips ir-align-* classes from the newly-split paragraph (via requestAnimationFrame after native insertParagraph) and no longer clones the alignment. Verified: (1) BLOCK LEFT/CENTER/RIGHT apply correct class to current

with no class (text 'after' left-aligned, 'Center'

intact and still ir-align-center); (4) Enter at end of ir-align-right produces fresh

with no class ('after2' left-aligned, 'Right' intact); (5) Enter from middle of 'Center' splits into 'Ce' (still ir-align-center) + 'nter' (no class) — strip happens regardless of split position; (6) Enter in a plain

(no align class) produces two plain

after; Backspace at offset 0 of empty Right cell keeps row intact at 3 cells; (8) Save/Reopen round-trip: after close+reopen (same session), the three ir-align-* classes persist and the exit-created plain

FROZEN_TOOLS_regression.note: Bold-via-toolbar did not wrap selection — same anomaly flagged in iteration_119. Unrelated to this iteration's keydown change.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking floating-rte-btn-bold on a selected plain word did not wrap the selection in <strong>/<b> (italic/underline/h1 all worked on the same selection in the same run). Pre-existing from iteration_119; NOT caused by this iteration's keydown changes.

action_items: LOW: Investigate Bold toolbar button not wrapping selection in <strong>. Same anomaly reported in iteration_119 and still reproducible. Not blocking the BLOCK Return-exit fix, but should be fixed separately. Repro: in fullscreen-content-input-format with text 'plain', Ctrl+A to select, click floating-rte-btn-bold — selection remains unbolded while italic/underline/h1 still work on the same selection.
critical_code_review_comments: BLOCK Return-exit implementation at FloatingRichTextToolbar.jsx L2108-2126 is correct and minimal: it lets the browser do the native insertParagraph (preserving caret, inline formatting, split semantics) and then strips ir-align-* classes from the new block on the next animation frame. ALIGN_CLASSES.forEach + removeAttribute('class') when empty is clean. The dispatchEvent('input') after mutation correctly notifies the save pipeline, as verified by the SAVE_REOPEN scenario.

The gating `const block = findAlignBlockAncestor(ed, range.startContainer); if (!block) return;` and `const hadAlign = ALIGN_CLASSES.some(c => block.classList.contains(c)); if (!hadAlign) return;` correctly isolates the fix to blocks that actually carry an ir-align-* class, so plain

Enter is a true no-op (regression guard verified).
File size is still ~4305 lines. Extracting AlignPanel, HighlightPanel, AppearancePanel and the INLINE row/BLOCK align keydown helpers into their own modules remains overdue.

success_rate.frontend: 11/11 critical scenarios PASS (100%). One LOW-priority Bold-via-toolbar anomaly observed; pre-existing from iteration_119 and unchanged by this iteration.

rca_of_the_issue:
The bug description reported that pressing Enter in an ir-align-*

cloned the class to the new paragraph (native insertParagraph clones block tag + classes). The fix at FloatingRichTextToolbar.jsx L2108-2126 adds a NEW BLOCK branch below the pre-existing INLINE branch in the keydown handler: it (a) early-returns if the caret is not inside an ir-align-* ancestor, (b) lets the browser do native insertParagraph, and (c) schedules a requestAnimationFrame cleanup that walks the Selection post-split to the NEW block and strips ir-align-* classes, removing the class attribute entirely when empty. An input event is dispatched to notify the save pipeline. The fix is empirically verified for all five Enter positions (end of center, end of right, middle of center via text offset 2, plain-p no-op, inline-cell unchanged) and persists through close+reopen within the same session.
